purpose: Full recorded V2 rank-0 profiling-window accounting, requested by the owner; exclusive semantic component accounting is stored in the companion native-JSON summary.

scope.hardware: 8 x NVIDIA H100 80GB NVLink, single node

method: Actual Perfetto MCP analysis; thread_slice from slices.with_context, original actual CUDA stream ID from args.stream.
All 9930 kernel/memcpy/memset events have CPU launch flow linkage. The three-microbatch window intersects 9921; nine setup events precede it.
GPU busy and idle use interval unions; exclusive stream activity uses a sweep of all event endpoints.

Early temporal forward is microbatch entry to the first main-stream device event launched after the first autograd engine entry. It is not semantic forward: ChunkedCELoss interleaves first-time head forward and head backward.
Semantic original-forward/recompute/backward attribution is separately provided by v2-window-component-summary.json and its per-kernel evidence.
Kernel sums across concurrent streams must not be added to elapsed time; EP/NCCL kernel activity may include device peer/spin waits.
These are measurements of the captured diagnostic prefix, not full-step percentages, optimization gains or all-rank bottleneck proof.

queries.label: construct_and_phase_boundaries
queries.sql:
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE win26_dev AS
SELECT d.*,CAST(EXTRACT_ARG(d.arg_set_id,'args.stream') AS INT) stream,
CASE WHEN d.category='gpu_memcpy' THEN 'copy' WHEN d.category='gpu_memset' THEN 'memset'
WHEN d.name GLOB '*hybrid_ep*' OR d.name GLOB '*ag_nvl*' OR d.name GLOB '*rs_nvl*'
OR lower(d.name) GLOB '*deep_ep*' OR lower(d.name) GLOB '*deepep*' THEN 'ep'
WHEN lower(d.name) GLOB '*nccl*' THEN 'nccl' ELSE 'compute' END kind,
h.id host_id,h.ts host_ts,h.dur host_dur,h.name host_name,h.tid host_tid
FROM thread_slice d JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=d.id JOIN thread_slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out
WHERE d.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset');
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE win26_mb AS
WITH m AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ts) mb,id,ts,ts+dur cpu_end
FROM thread_slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name GLOB 'task.profile_update.*.microbatch.rank0')
SELECT *, (SELECT max(ts+dur) FROM win26_dev d WHERE d.host_ts>=m.ts AND d.host_ts<m.cpu_end) device_end,
(SELECT min(ts) FROM thread_slice a WHERE a.name GLOB 'autograd::engine::evaluate_function:*' AND a.ts>=m.ts AND a.ts<m.cpu_end) bwd_cpu_start
FROM m;
SELECT m.mb,(m.ts-(SELECT min(ts) FROM win26_mb))/1e6 start_ms,
(m.cpu_end-m.ts)/1e6 host_span_ms,(m.device_end-m.ts)/1e6 device_span_ms,
(m.bwd_cpu_start-m.ts)/1e6 backward_host_start_ms,
(SELECT min(d.ts)-m.ts FROM win26_dev d WHERE d.stream=7 AND d.host_ts>=m.bwd_cpu_start AND d.host_ts<m.cpu_end)/1e6 first_backward_gpu_ms
FROM win26_mb m;

queries.label: construct_occupancy_and_phases
phase_occupancy
queries.sql:
WITH x AS(
SELECT p.mb,p.phase,p.b pb,p.e pe,d.id,d.kind,d.stream,MAX(p.b,d.b) b,MIN(p.e,d.e) e
FROM win26_phase p JOIN win26_events d ON d.b<p.e AND d.e>p.b WHERE p.e>p.b),
a AS(SELECT mb,phase,id,'all_device' kind,b,e FROM x UNION ALL SELECT mb,phase,id,'main_stream',b,e FROM x WHERE stream=7 UNION ALL SELECT mb,phase,id,kind,b,e FROM x),
y AS(SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(PARTITION BY mb,phase,kind ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM a)
SELECT phase,kind,sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b))))/1e6 union_ms,sum(e-b)/1e6 sum_ms FROM y GROUP BY phase,kind ORDER BY phase,kind;

queries.label: phase_elapsed
queries.sql: SELECT phase,sum(e-b)/1e6 elapsed_ms FROM win26_phase WHERE e>b GROUP BY phase;

queries.label: main_stream_families
queries.sql: SELECT stream,kind,count(*) n,sum(e-b)/1e6 sum_ms FROM win26_events GROUP BY stream,kind ORDER BY stream,kind;

queries.label: nccl_families
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN name GLOB '*AllGather*' THEN 'allgather' WHEN name GLOB '*ReduceScatter*' THEN 'reduce_scatter' WHEN name GLOB '*AllReduce*' THEN 'allreduce' ELSE name END family,count(*) n,sum(e-b)/1e6 sum_ms FROM win26_events WHERE kind='nccl' GROUP BY family;

queries.label: full_train_census
queries.sql:
WITH w AS(SELECT ts lo,ts+dur hi FROM thread_slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name='task.profile_update.21.train_step.rank0'),
x AS(SELECT d.id,d.kind,d.category,MAX(d.ts,w.lo) b,MIN(d.ts+d.dur,w.hi) e FROM win26_dev d JOIN w ON d.ts<w.hi AND d.ts+d.dur>w.lo),
p AS(SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM x)
SELECT count(*) events,(SELECT hi-lo FROM w)/1e6 window_ms,
sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b))))/1e6 busy_ms,
((SELECT hi-lo FROM w)-sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b)))))/1e6 idle_ms
FROM p;

queries.label: full_train_margin_work
queries.sql:
SELECT d.kind,d.name,d.stream,(d.ts-(SELECT min(ts) FROM win26_mb))/1e6 start_ms,d.dur/1e6 duration_ms
FROM win26_dev d WHERE d.ts<(SELECT lo FROM win26_win) ORDER BY d.ts;

queries.label: phase_main_idle
queries.sql:
WITH x AS(SELECT d.id,p.phase,MAX(d.b,p.b)b,MIN(d.e,p.e)e FROM win26_events d JOIN win26_phase p ON d.b<p.e AND d.e>p.b WHERE d.stream=7 AND p.e>p.b),
y AS(SELECT *,MAX(e)OVER(PARTITION BY phase ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)prev_end FROM x)
SELECT phase,sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b))))/1e6 main_busy_ms,
(SELECT sum(e-b)/1e6 FROM win26_phase p WHERE p.phase=y.phase AND e>b)-sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b))))/1e6 main_idle_ms FROM y GROUP BY phase;

queries.label: phase_margin_markers
queries.sql: SELECT name,(ts-(SELECT min(ts) FROM win26_mb))/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 duration_ms FROM thread_slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name IN ('ProfilerStep#20','task.profile_update.21.train_step.rank0') ORDER BY ts;

queries.label: exposed_other_stream_work
queries.sql:
WITH m AS(SELECT * FROM win26_events WHERE stream=7),
p AS(SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM m),
g AS(SELECT prev_end b,b e FROM p WHERE b>prev_end
UNION ALL SELECT w.lo,(SELECT min(b) FROM m) FROM win26_win w
UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT max(e) FROM m),w.hi FROM win26_win w)
SELECT CASE WHEN d.name GLOB '*AllGather*' THEN 'all_gather' WHEN d.name GLOB '*ReduceScatter*' THEN 'reduce_scatter'
WHEN d.name GLOB '*AllReduce*' THEN 'all_reduce' WHEN d.kind='copy' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'GFSDP_preparation_kernels' END family,
count(DISTINCT d.id) n,sum(MIN(d.e,g.e)-MAX(d.b,g.b))/1e6 intersects_main_idle_ms
FROM win26_events d JOIN g ON d.b<g.e AND d.e>g.b WHERE d.stream<>7 GROUP BY family;

queries.label: disjoint_elapsed_occupancy
queries.sql:
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE win26_sweep AS
WITH endpoints AS(
SELECT b t,CASE WHEN stream=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END dm,CASE WHEN stream=24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ds,CASE WHEN stream=23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END dc,1 da FROM win26_events
UNION ALL SELECT e,CASE WHEN stream=7 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN stream=24 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN stream=23 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END,-1 FROM win26_events
UNION ALL SELECT lo,0,0,0,0 FROM win26_win UNION ALL SELECT hi,0,0,0,0 FROM win26_win),
grouped AS(SELECT t,sum(dm)dm,sum(ds)ds,sum(dc)dc,sum(da)da FROM endpoints GROUP BY t),
running AS(SELECT t,lead(t)OVER(ORDER BY t) e,sum(dm)OVER(ORDER BY t)m,sum(ds)OVER(ORDER BY t)s,sum(dc)OVER(ORDER BY t)c,sum(da)OVER(ORDER BY t)a FROM grouped)
SELECT * FROM running WHERE e>t;
SELECT CASE WHEN m>0 THEN 'main_stream_active'
WHEN s>0 AND c>0 THEN 'main_idle_GFSDP_and_capacity_AR_active'
WHEN s>0 THEN 'main_idle_GFSDP_stream_active'
WHEN c>0 THEN 'main_idle_capacity_AR_active'
ELSE 'all_device_idle' END state,sum(e-t)/1e6 elapsed_ms FROM win26_sweep GROUP BY state;

main_stream_kernel_rows.component: MLA including projections, MTP and helpers
Dense FFN and shared expert GEMMs

presentation.caution: Semantic replay/VJP split is an operational estimate for fused mixed kernels. GDN/MLA projections, shared/dense FFN and router GEMM ownership use source-order inference. Direct strong family anchors are output-head GEMMs, routed expert GEMMs, HybridEP, GDN scan and SDPA.
presentation.earlier_idle_number_reconciliation: 42.899ms counted internal gaps only. 43.112190ms includes the leading/trailing edges of the full three-microbatch window.
presentation.review: Independent bounded source/method review found no concrete misclassified derivative kernel, accepted strong family anchors and required rounding to0.1ms with semantic and inferred-ownership caveats.
